name: B10-0536/2025 (ESN) – Rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
This text is a motion for a resolution from a political group. It does not change any law. It asks Tunisia to give Sonia Dahmani medical care and access to a lawyer, and to run her trials fairly. It also supports Tunisian rules against foreign funding of groups, backs tougher action against illegal migration, and welcomes EU cooperation with Tunisia on returns.

- Sonia Dahmani: the text asks Tunisia for medical care and legal access; no decision is binding.
- Tunisian groups: the text backs the 2018 law limiting foreign funding; no new rule is created.
- Migration: the text supports border security and return deals; EU-Tunisia talks would follow.
